notes.title: Interface Update
notes.content:
Hello players,

This update brought changes mainly in the interface. Following are the changes:

[h1]Fear Bar, Goal and Controls[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517367/dafe4928eb1a44371f8f0171a58b695004243d84.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Fear Bar:[/b] The position was changed to the top. This help the player to stay tuned along with goals.
[*] [b]Your Goal:[/b] This information will clear to you what your goal at the moment.
[*] [b]Controls:[/b] This will greatly help new players.
[/list]

[h1]Items Collected and Scores[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517367/718e6b426bba862376d6aa49341fb2ccbfb72cb2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Items Collected:[/b]These counters show the amount of items that were collected during this gameplay and will help track the performance to unlock the achievements of the Steam.
[*] [b]Scores:[/b] The scores of the sum total of life time points (Rush), your best score during a gameplay and your current score.
[/list]

[h1]Pop Up Values[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517367/0916d4bf609f844bec6f18d1ff16b7f13d196f38.png[/img]

This information is displayed when you collect an item showing the value of the fear, life and item points you acquired when you picked it up.

I hope you like.

Developer

notes.title: Fixed FPS issue
notes.content:
Some players have faced FPS problem. This small patch limits the FPS up to 60 and disables V-Sync.

If you still have problem please contact me.

Developer

notes.title: Rounds and Power-ups In a Row
notes.content:
Hello players, 

I've been working on some gameplay changes. This update brought a new feature to the game.

You can continue to collect all items at will but now has been included a list of power-ups that must be collected in the presented order. [b][i] When all 6 power-ups are collected, your fear bar is reset and you advance one round. Each round multiples the values of the power-ups. [/i][/b]  If you collect an item that is not requested currently, a new list will be created.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29517367/402fda6e0e690c7c3ac49cb81e56db3890a97ed4.png[/img]

Now, in the start screen, there is an indication to play in full screen. Just press ALT+ENTER any time.

I hope you like. Thanks you for playing!

Developer

notes.title: Global Leaderboards
notes.content:
Hello players! 

This update brought the global leaderboards. Now the maximum score of the player during a single match will be considered for the ranking.

Open your game once to update your points and enter for the rank.

Good luck!

Developer

notes.title: Rain Weather
notes.content:
Hello players! 

This update brought a new weather to the environment. The rain increases / decreases according to the bar of fear.

I hope you enjoy it and waiting your feedback!

Developer

notes.title: Jump & Improvements
notes.content:
Hello players! This update brought a new experience. See the changes below:
[list]
[*] [b]Jump[/b] - The character gained the ability to jump. Which brings you the opportunity to reach the items faster and dodge from others unwanted items.
[*] [b]Change in item drop rate[/b] - The drop speed varies according to the bar of fear. More fear, more drop. The amount of skulls increased and hearts / potions reduced significantly.
[*] [b]Start Screen[/b] - The start screen show the commands available in the game.
[*] [b]Menu/Pause[/b] - During the game, press "Escape" to pause or quit.
[*] [b]Heartbeat Sounf Effect[/b] - The heart beat plays constantly and increases / decreases according to the bar of fear.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy it and waiting your feedback!

Developer
